findings.title: Translation cache key ignores the fallback chain, which depends on site default locale
findings.body: Cached translations are keyed only by key, locale and backend. With fallbacks, the result for a missing key now depends on SiteSetting.default_locale. When the default locale changes, or differs between multisite sites in the same process, the LRU cache keeps serving stale or wrong-site fallback strings.

findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded outside controller requests
findings.body: translate only loads config.locale. The fallback locales are loaded only by I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! in ApplicationController#set_locale. Jobs, mailers, rake tasks and any other non-controller code never load the site-default or :en translations. In those contexts, fallback lookups to unloaded locales return 'translation missing'.

findings.title: Fallback list may contain a locale string alongside its symbol
findings.body: The current locale is passed through unchanged while the site default is converted to a symbol. If the locale arrives as a string (for example 'en'), uniq does not collapse it with :en. The same locale is then looked up twice, and ensure_loaded! tracks both forms.
